classification_basis: largest contiguous usable foundation-equivalent core; total polygon area is secondary

small.intent: local or satellite production; limited expansion

medium.intent: dedicated factory with meaningful miner/belt upgrade headroom

large.intent: major production district intended to survive multiple throughput upgrades

very_large.intent: regional or late-game industrial campus where terrain should not be the primary growth constraint

workable.interpretation: usable for most factories with some layout constraint

linear.interpretation: long/narrow surface; potentially useful for linear production but not general-purpose

poor.interpretation: too elongated to treat raw area as equivalent general-purpose industrial capacity

notes: Size thresholds remain parameterized calibration defaults and are expected to change after in-game validation.
Horizontal working resolution, within-cell relief tolerance, neighbor-step tolerance, and total region vertical span are independent parameters.
Region segmentation uses aligned elevation bands so 2/4/8/16 m Z-span variants progressively merge rather than allowing unlimited transitive climbing.
Grade and roughness are always measured; they are only exclusion gates when a threshold is supplied.
Shape class is reported separately from size class; elongated regions are not silently rejected or down-sized.
Cross-resolution merging remains deferred; Z-span variants are deliberately preserved for calibration.
